msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia agaiz-collection-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing an emerald green satin Moroccan takchita with a gold embroidered front panel and a gold belt from the reference, walking at the Plaça del Mercadal in Reus, Spain, with its modernist buildings, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia agaiz-collection-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing an emerald green satin Moroccan takchita with a gold embroidered front panel and a gold belt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia agaiz-collection-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a red velvet Moroccan caftan with heavy gold embroidery and a gold belt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia agaiz-collection-02.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a fuchsia satin takchita with gold trim and a gold belt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia agaiz-collection-15.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a white Moroccan caftan with silver embroidery and a train from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
